explanation.text: Short drills, one after another. For each one, click in the box and start typing. The timer starts on your first key and stops when you have typed all the text. You see your **speed in WPM** and your **accuracy**.

items: Look at the text, **not your hands**.
Green letters are correct. Red wavy letters are mistakes. The grey block is the next letter.
A try is saved as your best only when accuracy is **95% or more**. Speed does not count if you rush and make mistakes.
Do each drill a few times. Your best speed is saved in this browser.

explanation.text: Do not delete and fix every small mistake with a panic. Stay calm, keep the same rhythm, and slow down a little. Calm typing gets faster by itself.

quiz.question: A typing try is saved as your best when…
options: accuracy is 95% or more and the speed beats your best
you type the fastest of all
quiz.explanation: Speed only counts when it is accurate. Below 95% accuracy the try is not saved.

quiz.question: What should you look at while you type?
quiz.explanation: Looking at the screen trains your fingers to find the keys by feel.
